packages.name: SharedFiles
packages.description: The folder the wesleyasaurus Mario, Olimar and Melee mods share: put your own GameCube disc images in put_games_here. No code.

packages.name: Mario
packages.description: Mario with FLUDD from Super Mario Sunshine as a survivor. Needs your own Sunshine disc. A Melee disc adds the Luigi skin. Offline and friends-only.

packages.name: Olimar
packages.description: Olimar and the Pikmin from Pikmin as a survivor, plus the Ship Repair mode. Needs your own Pikmin disc; Pikmin 2 and Melee discs add skins and enemies. Offline and friends-only.

packages.name: Melee
packages.description: Samus and Yoshi from Super Smash Bros. Melee as survivors. Needs your own Melee disc (USA, revision 1.02). Offline and friends-only.
